_comment: The working piece of each template and WooCommerce page a site serves (Spec 48 FR-48-56, FR-48-87, FR-48-96, FR-48-99): the block that must really work there, so a clone never ships a static imitation of a basket, a checkout, a buy box, a product list or an order. Read by lib/template-pieces.mjs. `templates` is keyed by template slug, `pages` by the commerce role of an ordinary page (lib/skeleton-commerce-region.mjs::commerceOf). Each piece: `id`; `block`, the block that must be in the built tree, and/or `binds` ({ source, key }: a block bound to that source and key, since a bound text has no block name of its own); `required` (true: the tree fails the check without it; false: placed only where the draft draws it); `once` (default true: more than one fails the check); `kind`, who places it. Kind `rule` is placed by an existing skeleton rule named in `by`, and kind `theme` comes with the theme template's own content (lib/template-copies.mjs::themeContent); neither is built here, both are checked. A template may carry `dataBranches: true`: its surface's inventory also reads the branches the draft shows only for some data (lib/skeleton-data-branches.mjs), for a template whose working pieces need them in the skeleton; a state a working block draws itself is never read in. Any other kind names a builder, lib/template-piece-<kind>.mjs, whose `place( ctx, piece )` puts the piece into the tree; `find` and `bind` are that builder's own inputs (how the draft region is found by structure, and what is bound to live data). Kind `woo-layout` (lib/template-piece-woo-layout.mjs) makes WooCommerce's block stand in for the whole element laying out the form beside the order summary and keeps the form column's own heading above it; kind `frame` (lib/template-piece-frame.mjs) marks the header and footer the copy holds (lib/template-frame.mjs); kind `account` (lib/template-piece-account.mjs) writes the account block's signed-out view, its card's and forms' words and its signed-in tab headings from the draft, by the parts data/account-parts.json names. A surface building no template the map names takes the pieces of its commerce page role (`pages`).
